# Awesome AI Model Showcases

Awesome AI Model Showcases collects real public production cases from the latest large models (Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon, GPT-6.2 Sol, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, and others) and from the previous generation that is still mainstream: GIFs, animations, HTML and game demos, and images, each with the original post, author, published prompt, and method.

中文：AI 模型制作案例集收录最新一代大模型（Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2、Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon、GPT-6.2 Sol、Grok、Qwen、DeepSeek 等）以及上一代仍在主流使用的模型的真实制作案例：动图、动画、HTML / 游戏 demo、图像；每条都附原帖、作者、公开的提示词和做法。

Independent community project. Organized by model family, then version. Current public inventory, not exhaustive. Author claim ≠ official verification.

## What is this repository?
A sourced catalog of real production cases from the latest large models: animations, HTML and game demos, images, and credited local videos. Each record keeps the post, author, prompt-or-empty, model evidence, pipeline, verification, and license boundary. The GPT Image 2.6 GIF archive is a subproject at collections/gpt-image-gifs/ and is not part of the homepage total.

## What is in the current inventory?
Homepage total 26 frontier-family cases: Claude 7, Gemini 3, GPT-6.2 Sol 11, Grok 2, Qwen 1, DeepSeek 2. GPT Image subproject 51 (X 25 + web GIF 20 + in-repo 2 + game author-claim 4), listed only under collections/gpt-image-gifs/. GPT-6.2 Sol is the owner catalog label; OpenAI public pages still list GPT-6.1 Sol. Claude Mythos 5.2 is named in the inventory and has no separate sourced case. Pending 12. Prompt-only 1. Excluded 9. Appendix 50. Seeds 6. Officially verified 2.6 game outputs: 0. One JSON source: docs/data/community-cases.json. English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese READMEs share the homepage inventory. Showcase collection sites: playbooks/research/showcase-collection-sites.json. Case index: docs/showcase-index.md and data/showcase-index.json. Failed video downloads: docs/missing-videos.md.

## What can I do with it?
Browse https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-ai-model-showcases/?lang=en (EN) or ?lang=zh (中文). Open local media and published prompts or labeled excerpts under docs/cases/<id>/. Follow source licenses and provenance notes. Original URLs are citations. Submit cases. Do not treat SVG concept covers or prompt_adaptation as originals.

## What can it not do?
No Images API at browse time. No paid generation. No blanket author-grant or CC0 claim. No exhaustive-web or official-verification claim. Appendix idea/popular pages are Chinese-first and not a second inventory.

## Which languages are maintained?
English README.md, Simplified Chinese README.zh-CN.md (AI 模型制作案例集), Traditional Chinese README.zh-TW.md, and Japanese README.ja.md. Same inventory and the same case counts. The web gallery is still English and Simplified Chinese (`?lang=en` / `?lang=zh`).

## License boundaries
MIT covers source code only. Third-party media remains license-unknown unless a specific source grant is recorded. Follow per-case attribution; no blanket grant or CC0 claim.
